final_message:
All 10 tests pass, plus edge-case smoke checks match the README.

- `src/lexer.ts` — scans for `{{`/`{{{`, closes on `}}`/`}}}`, trims tag bodies, and classifies `#if path`, `else`, `/if`, and value tokens; throws `unterminated tag` when a tag never closes, while lone braces in text pass through.
- `src/lookup.ts` — `lookup` walks dotted segments through objects/arrays using `Object.hasOwn` only (so `constructor`, `__proto__`, and `name.length` miss), returning `undefined` on any gap; `isTruthy` is JS truthiness except empty arrays are false.
- `src/render.ts` — validates block structure up front (`unexpected {{else}}`, `unexpected {{/if}}`, `unclosed {{#if}}`), renders via recursion over tokens (nested if/else aware), evaluates `path | filter: arg` chains left to right (`upper`, `lower`, `default`), then converts with `String(...)` and `escapeHtml` unless triple braces were used.
